stick-shrug.use_when: A fact lands and there is nothing to do about it but shrug.

stick-face-down.use_when: The number is so bad the only honest reaction is lying on the floor.

stick-umbrella-red-arrows.use_when: Standing under a sell-off like weather — a rain of red arrows.

stick-staring-at-crash.use_when: Watching a chart fall in real time and doing nothing.

stick-pointing.use_when: Pointing at the number like exhibit A — 'look at it.'

arrow-up-scribble.use_when: A crude up arrow when the crowd thinks something only goes up.

arrow-down-scribble.use_when: A crude red down arrow for the part of the chart nobody screenshots.

circle-scribble.use_when: Circling the one number that actually matters.

underline-scribble.use_when: Underlining a phrase that deserves a second read.

wedge-diagram.use_when: Drawing the 'pattern' with unearned confidence — technical analysis, allegedly.

payoff-diagram.use_when: The napkin payoff diagram for a trade that definitely can't go wrong.

money-bag.use_when: The theoretical money at the end of the plan.

money-stack.use_when: A drawn pile of cash — the imaginary kind.

scribble-explosion.use_when: The account, the thesis, or the balance sheet detonating.
